_comment: CMDAI CODE - MCP servers. Copy to mcp_config.json and edit that instead.
mcp_config.json holds tokens, so it is gitignored. This example is tracked.
stdio           the client launches the command and talks over stdin/stdout
http            Streamable HTTP, for a server that runs on its own
Give tokens through env using ${VAR}, not literally. The value is read from
your environment at launch, so the secret stays out of this file:
Keys may also be a bare map, or use the key mcp_servers, if you are copying
a block written for another client.
Servers can be added from the command line instead:
cmdai mcp list | remove | enable | disable

mcpServers._comment_slow_start: A server that takes a while to boot. No autostart means it connects only when you ask for it with /mcp restart NAME.
mcpServers._comment_disabled: Configured but not started. `cmdai mcp enable slow-server` turns it back on.
